id: title:cvolzer3:prioritize foreground reads over inbox prefetch

review.posthog_relevance: Optimization of report loading performance and network efficiency in the PostHog frontend, specifically preventing redundant network requests and respecting shared cache state during report prefetching.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F6.H2 demonstrates a substantive implementation change: replacing a simple prefetch with an abortable, account-scoped, and shared-cache-aware implementation. This checks for existing observers and fetch status before issuing new requests, which is a bounded correctness and reliability improvement for the report loading capability. The chunk P1.F5.H2 adds a test to this
review.uncertainty: The chunk P1.F1.H1 is documentation only and does not establish a tier. The tier is assigned based on P1.F6.H2. The actual runtime benefit and user experience improvement are not independently verified, and the chunk P1.F5.H2 is a supporting test rather than the implementation. No broader systemic risk reduction or broader capability change is demonstrated across other components.

observations.behavior: Documentation change: prefetch behavior and its conditions are rewritten; no code implementation.
observations.code_quote: The inbox waits for row visibility, then prefetches report detail, work log and Today page for visible rows plus one ahead. Earlier offscreen rows are excluded, and scrolling replaces queued work. There is no initial page-wide prefetch.
